name: Double Commander
author: Alexander Koblov
summary: Free cross platform open source file manager with two panels side by side
description:
Double Commander is a cross platform open source file manager with two panels side by side.
It is inspired by Total Commander and features some new ideas.

versions.release_notes:
This the bugfix release addressing known problems in 1.0.10 release.
Read the latest release changelog for more details about fixed bugs.
